title: Microsoft and Amazon Won the AI Spending Week. Alphabet, Meta, and Oracle Didn't. Now What?
excerpt: Are all these AI spending figures actually comparable? Not quite, and the fine print is where this five-company story gets interesting.
content_html:
Anders Bylund, The Motley Fool

Mon, August 3, 2026 at 5:57 AM MST 5 min read

The hyperscaler giants reported quarterly results over the last few weeks. Despite consistently impressive earnings and revenues, the market reactions were mixed. Capital expenditure (capex) planning was a better explanation for the stock moves than the usual earnings and revenue jumps.

  • Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) rose 18% and 10%, respectively, over the week of July 26-31. Investors applauded their approach to artificial intelligence data center investments.

  • Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL) dipped as much as 4% after its July 22 report but has since returned to positive territory over the last two weeks. The Google parent's capex plans were less comforting.

  • Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) dipped nearly 10% and is still down 6% over its reporting week. The company is late to the hyperscaler game, but leaning into its infrastructure investments with gusto.

  • Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) is a special case with a non-standard fiscal year, so its latest report inspired a 14% price drop in the second week of June. In total, stock prices are down 35% since the Q4 2026 report. The database giant is making a sharp strategic turn, and investors worry about massive costs.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

How different are these tech titans' AI investments, though? Their expenses look similar at first glance, but where will the money come from? Who can sustain this pace, and who is quietly bending the balance sheet, or the cash flow statement, to make it look easier than it is?

So I'm taking a deep look at the hyperscaler data center investments. Keep an eye on this space for further analysis and thematic comparisons.

I'll confess a selfish motive too. Half the reason to lay all five side by side is that I expect to understand the whole AI build-out story much better by the end than I did at the start. Learn it with me, starting with a simple overview of the basic facts.

安德斯·拜伦德 (Anders Bylund)，杂色傻瓜

2026 年 8 月 3 日星期一凌晨 5:57（MST） 阅读 5 分钟

超大规模巨头在过去几周公布了季度业绩。 尽管盈利和收入持续令人印象深刻，但市场反应却褒贬不一。 与通常的盈利和收入增长相比，资本支出（capex）计划是对股票走势的更好解释。

  • 7 月 26 日至 31 日当周，微软（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）和亚马逊（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）分别上涨 18% 和 10%。 投资者对他们的人工智能数据中心投资方式表示赞赏。
  • Alphabet（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）在 7 月 22 日发布报告后下跌了 4%，但在过去两周内已恢复正值。 谷歌母公司的资本支出计划并不那么令人欣慰。
  • Meta Platforms（纳斯达克股票代码：META）下跌近 10%，报告周仍下跌 6%。 该公司在超大规模领域起步较晚，但仍热衷于基础设施投资。
  • 甲骨文（纽约证券交易所代码：ORCL）是非标准财年的特例，因此其最新报告导致 6 月第二周股价下跌 14%。 自 2026 年第四季度报告发布以来，股价总共下跌了 35%。 这家数据库巨头正在做出急剧的战略转变，投资者担心巨额成本。

错过了 2009 年的 Nvidia？ 这个罕见的信号再次闪烁。 2009年，一家名不见经传的芯片制造商英伟达发出了“双倍下跌”的信号。 多年来，对于一家规模仅为 Nvidia 1/100 的公司来说，同样的“完全确信”信号闪烁。 继续 ”

然而，这些科技巨头的人工智能投资有何不同呢？ 乍一看，他们的开支很相似，但钱从哪里来呢？ 谁能维持这样的速度，谁在悄悄地改变资产负债表或现金流量表，让事情看起来比实际更容易？

因此，我正在深入研究超大规模数据中心的投资。 请密切关注此空间以进行进一步分析和主题比较。

我也会承认有一个自私的动机。 将所有五个并排放置的一半原因是，我希望到最后能比开始时更好地理解整个人工智能构建故事。 跟我一起学习，从基本事实的简单概述开始。
